name: The Furniture Ranch
old_description: Located at 20635 N Cave Creek Rd Phoenix, AZ 85024, The Furniture Ranch specializes in custom bedroom/dining room furniture and custom kitchen/home office furniture. Custom American-made furniture. Founded in 1997. All products are handcrafted and guaranteed. Call today.
about:
The Furniture Ranch, a family-owned business founded in 1997, operates from Phoenix, Arizona. The company began with a focus on custom American-made furniture, handcrafted from solid wood.

The shop produces a range of custom furniture including bedroom sets, dining room tables, home office pieces, Murphy beds, upholstery, occasional furniture, kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, and doors. All items are built to order using solid wood, and the company offers delivery throughout Arizona and neighboring states. A 10-year guarantee backs every product.

The Furniture Ranch serves residential customers across Arizona and surrounding states, working directly with homeowners and designers to create made-to-order pieces. Its showroom and workshop cater to clients seeking personalized furniture for homes, including custom cabinetry for kitchens and bathrooms.

The company emphasizes its family-owned heritage, 25-plus years of experience, and a commitment to unique custom designs as key differentiators. The 10-year guarantee reflects confidence in the durability of its handcrafted solid-wood construction.
